title: InstitutionalProspectsPowerBISchema
description: Enterprise Data Schema for Power BI Ingestion - AI-Powered Institutional Prospecting Engine

ticker.description: Public ticker symbol or corporate acronym

annual_revenue_m.description: Trailing Twelve Months (TTM) Revenue in Millions USD

ebitda_m.description: Earnings Before Interest, Taxes, Depreciation & Amortization ($M)

debt_to_equity.description: Total Debt over Total Shareholders Equity (Solvency indicator)

current_ratio.description: Current Assets over Current Liabilities (Liquidity indicator)

quick_ratio.description: Liquid cash assets over current liabilities

altman_z_score.description: Empirical Credit Health Proxy (>2.6 Safe, 1.1-2.6 Grey, <1.1 Distress)

headline.description: Recent corporate press release or SEC disclosure headline
headline.example: NovaScale AI Systems Secures $140M in Growth Financing...

signal_sentiment_score.description: Normalized sentiment metric of market news (-1.0 to +1.0)

lead_probability_score.description: Module A Machine Learning Output: Definitively calibrated conversion score (0-100)

prospecting_summary.description: Module B LangChain Output: Executive briefing synthesizing financials and catalyst events

market_signals.description: Module B LangChain Output: Extracted high-impact signals and financial catalysts

talking_points.description: Module B LangChain Output: Actionable C-suite conversation openers and probing questions

pitch_angle.description: Module B LangChain Output: Recommended primary strategic value proposition

objection_handler.description: Module B LangChain Output: Proactive rebuttal strategy tailored to financial posture
